notes: KNOWN FAILING: DeepSeek Harness ships a foreground workflow tool that fans out three parallel spawn-provider children and writes each distinct childId into durable tool-workflow records. Each child transcript header carries parentSession. The DSH adapter rejects bare-UUID child directories and declares no ParentSessionIDFromPath extractor, so the correct spec requires three distinct child sessions and parent links that cannot appear today. Transcript assertions make the fixture non-vacuous by requiring one named workflow call, exactly three distinct durable workflow members, three completed member endings, and the successful three-agent result. The driver pins qwen/qwen3.5-9b; local-route cost can remain zero. The four former parent-scoped state-transition invariants were skipped by the verifier. The invariant DSL cannot bind parent to a session ID; removing the parent qualifier would also check child transitions. The phases check parent working at the start and ready at the end, but do not exclude intermediate parent transitions.
source: replaydata/agents/scenarios.json -> workflow-fanout, specialized for the DeepSeek Harness workflow tool
